npcs.name: Worker
lines: Whoa, hold on! The road east is buried.
Rocks came down during the night. CERULEAN is cut off for now.
If you're headed there, go through MT. MOON.

That tunnel to CERULEAN wears anyone out!

npcs.name: Badge Lass
lines: I want to be a GYM LEADER like him.

lines: Ouch! I tripped over a rock POKéMON, GEODUDE!
